::: {#sol-disk-square}

Let $(a, b) \in D$, so $a$ and $b$ are real numbers with $a^2 + b^2 \le 1$.
Then

$$
\ba
a^2
&\le a^2 + b^2
&& \text{(} b^2 \ge 0 \text{)}
\\&\le 1.
&& \text{(} (a, b) \in D \text{)}
\ea
$$

If $a > 1$, then $a^2 = a \cdot a > 1 \cdot 1 = 1$, and if $a < -1$, then $a^2 = (-a)^2 > 1$.
Neither is possible, so $-1 \le a \le 1$, that is, $a \in [-1, 1]$.
The same steps with $a$ and $b$ swapped give $b \in [-1, 1]$.
So $(a, b) \in [-1, 1] \times [-1, 1]$.
Every element of $D$ is in $[-1, 1] \times [-1, 1]$, so $D \subseteq [-1, 1] \times [-1, 1]$.

:::
